title: There's a Hole in What You See
pause_note: Short format v3: 20-30 s, claim first, loop ending

beats: There's a hole in what you see.
Where the optic nerve leaves your eye, there are no light sensors at all.
Your brain fills that spot with whatever surrounds it.
Try it: close your left eye and stare at the cross.
Move your phone slowly closer. The dot vanishes.
